about_item: 【Perfect Fit for 41" & 42" Dog Crates】Specifically sized at 41"x27"x4" to fit standard 41-inch and 42-inch dog crates. Ideal for crate training, this low-profile design fits perfectly without taking up excess headroom, making it the best dog crate pad for travel or home kennels.

【Orthopedic Egg Crate Foam for Joint Relief】Features 4-inch high-density egg crate memory foam that distributes weight evenly to soothe pressure points. Perfect for senior dogs, large breeds, or pets with arthritis and hip dysplasia, providing firm orthopedic support up to 80 lbs.

【Machine Washable & Removable Cover】The soft, plush rabbit fur cover features a durable L-shaped zipper for easy removal. It is 100% machine washable and dryer safe, allowing you to quickly clean pet hair, dirt, or accidents and keep the bed fresh.

【Waterproof Lining & Non-Slip Bottom】Includes a 100% PVC waterproof liner to prevent urine and spills from soaking into the foam. The heavy-duty Oxford fabric base has a non-slip dot design to keep the bed securely in place on tile, hardwood, or crate floors.
【Soft And Warm】The cozy faux rabbit fur surface provides a warm, particularly effective at calming and soothing pets. This orthopedic crate dog bed offers proven durability.
